name: delivery
description: Ticket-to-production chain: build-it (implement + PR + staging), blast-radius (impact report), qa-it (QA plan and run), ship-it (post-merge close-out and monitoring). Generic: your tracker, repos, deploy signals and channels come from the options below and ~/.claude/delivery-skills/.

tracker.title: Ticket tracker
tracker.description: Where your tickets live. The skills use its MCP connector.

ticket_prefix.title: Ticket ID prefix
ticket_prefix.description: How ticket IDs appear in branch names and PR titles, e.g. sc- (sc-123) or ENG- (ENG-42).

ticket_done_state.title: Done state
ticket_done_state.description: Workflow state ship-it moves a shipped ticket to.

gh_org.title: GitHub org
gh_org.description: GitHub org (or user) that owns your repos.

code_root.title: Code folder
code_root.description: Folder holding your local clones (used for cross-repo search and worktree cleanup).

repo_globs.title: Repo layout
repo_globs.description: Space-separated globs under the code folder that hold one clone each, e.g. "*" or "apps/* services/*".

staging_branch.title: Staging branch
staging_branch.description: QA/staging branch. Leave empty if you have none.

bump_path.title: GitOps bump path (optional)
bump_path.description: If CI writes deploy-bump commits (e.g. "[no ci] Bump prod to 1234"), the folder they touch, e.g. deliver_vars. Leave empty to detect deploys from GitHub Deployments.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone for report times and monitoring checks, e.g. Europe/London or Asia/Dubai.

owner_name.title: Your name
owner_name.description: How you appear in reports ("confirmed by <name>").

chat_tool.title: Chat tool
chat_tool.description: Where ship-it drafts announcements. Posts go out as you, only after you approve them.

owner_chat_id.title: Your chat user ID
owner_chat_id.description: Your user ID in the chat tool, for @-mentions (e.g. Slack U0123456789).

todo_app.title: Todo app
todo_app.description: Where ship-it creates post-deploy monitoring reminders. "none" prints the plan instead.

todo_project.title: Todo project / list
todo_project.description: Project or list for monitoring tasks (add its ID if the app needs one).
